description: Expected results for the official GeoClaw regression test geoclaw/tests/bowl_slosh (github.com/clawpack/geoclaw, commit 37d0bf5): water sloshing in a parabolic bowl, 41x41 base grid plus one AMR level (ratio 4), run to t = 0.5 s, one gauge at (0.5, 0.5) and one fgmax grid. The gauge and fgmax values come from the OFFICIAL regression_data/ files that ship with the test, and the tolerances are the official ones from clawpack check_gauges (rtol 1e-14, atol 1e-8) and check_fgmax (allclose rtol 1e-14, atol 1e-8). A check passes when |value - expected| <= tol + rtol*|expected|.
engine_version: Clawpack 5.14.0 (python package) with Fortran sources geoclaw 37d0bf5, amrclaw 98ba14a (tag v5.14.0), clawutil 02bcfb4, riemann f4ac312; GNU Fortran 13.3.0

reference: Gauge and fgmax values: official geoclaw/tests/bowl_slosh/regression_data (gauge00001.txt, regression_data_fgmax.txt). n_frames and final_frame_time follow from setrun.py. Clean runs of this package on 2026-10-05 matched the official data exactly: max |diff| of h, hu, hv, eta at gauge 1 = 0 (all 55 records), fgmax sums equal to the printed digits. Two runs gave the same result.
